settings.about_text:
J.K. Neuhauser was founded in 1956 as an Electrical Manufacturers Representative Firm to be the top representative firm in the Midwest. As the year passed, J.K. Neuhauser has expanded their services to the HVAC/R industry.

In the year 2013, Neuhauser merged with Manufacturers Associated Sales Agents Inc. (MASA Inc.). MASA Inc. was founded in 1985 with the mission to become the leading Manufacturers Rep Firm in the Great Lakes Region.

After the 2013 merger, both companies aligned their strategic vision to represent only the top brands from industry leading manufacturers. J.K. Neuhauser continues to uphold this vision today.
